reason: Project lens: src/sky_hazel.6502 is neither GENERATED nor PROTECTED (grind_config.py), not raster-timed; sky_col_row (&DF1F, HAZEL hazel_b) has no entries past its label, no self-modified operands. Same 9 bytes (STA zp 2, CMP abs,X 3, BCC 2, BNE 2 vs STA 2, LDA abs,X 3, CMP zp 2, BCC 2), so hazel_b's &E000 ASSERT and everything after (.no at &DF48) is unchanged in place; branches stay in range. Reads the same RAM as before (sky_ry &BCB4,X in bank 4 workspace, X<SKY_ROWS=6 so no page cross either way; sky_stop &E2 sky scratch, still stored first) under whatever ROMSEL/ACCCON the callers (sky_col_check in HAZEL, sky_col_zero in sky_edges) run with: no new address touched, no data moved, no new RAM. Condition: old fails iff ry<stop; new CMP sky_ry with A=stop: C=0 (stop<ry) pass, Z=1 pass, else (stop>ry) no - identical. A after the block differs (stop vs ry) but LDA sky_rl,X overwrites it; on .no, SEC/RTS and callers read only C. Both callers only test C then use s_ptr/Y/sky_stop. Sky mode is play-only (helicopters over sky), no front-end/game-over path differs. Cycles: in-path 12 -> 10 (stop<ry) or 11 (equal); no-path 13 -> 12.
